headers.name: YPY-Validate
headers.description: Sent by a field check with the name of the field. With batching on (`ypy-validate-batch`), the names of every field asked in the window, separated by commas (`email,username`). The server must answer without saving anything: 422 with the message markup when the field is invalid, 204 when it is valid. For a batch: 422 when any field is invalid, with the message of each invalid field as an out-of-band element (`<small id="email-error" ypy-swap-oob="innerHTML">...</small>`) whose id is the id of that field's place; 2xx when all are valid.
headers.value: the field name, or the names separated by commas

classes.name: ypy-field-error
classes.description: Applied to the answer element the extension creates after a field when the page has none.

attributes.name: ypy-validate-fields
attributes.description: Checks every field inside this element on the server when the user leaves it: a POST with the form values and the `YPY-Validate` header (the field name). The value is the URL; a bare attribute asks the form's action. A field with `ypy-validate="false"` is left out.

attributes.name: ypy-validate-trigger
attributes.description: When a field is checked: a trigger specification. Default `change delay:200ms` (the value changed, debounced). Read on the field or on the element with `ypy-validate-fields`.

attributes.name: ypy-validate-batch
attributes.description: Sends the fields of one form that ask the same URL within a short window in a single request, with `YPY-Validate: field1,field2`. The value is the window as a time; a bare attribute means `50ms`; `false` turns it off. Read on the field, on the element with `ypy-validate-fields` or on the form (the nearest wins), and from `validate.batch` in the configuration. Off by default: the server must read the list. One field alone is checked as without batching.

values.name: false
values.description: No batching for this field or region.

config.name: validate
config.description: Settings of the field validation on the server.

config.name: validate.batch
config.description: The window, as a time, in which the fields of one form that ask the same URL go in a single request. Off by default; `ypy-validate-batch` overrides it per field, region or form.
